LanguageData.RimScentExtended.Settings.TemperatureTip: Heat makes odours volatile, cold locks them down. A scent is at 40% below -10C, full strength at 20C, and 160% at 45C and above. Applies to pleasant and foul smells alike, so refrigerating a pile of corpses genuinely helps.
LanguageData.RimScentExtended.Settings.AdaptationTip: A constant smell stops being noticed, and hits again after time away. Without this, a colonist living next to a barn is unhappy forever with no way to get used to it.
LanguageData.RimScentExtended.Settings.Floor: Remaining strength once fully used to a smell: {0}
LanguageData.RimScentExtended.Settings.Hours: Hours of continuous exposure to get there: {0}
LanguageData.RimScentExtended.Settings.Pleasant: Also get used to pleasant smells
LanguageData.RimScentExtended.Settings.PleasantTip: On: you get used to your own incense and perfume just as you get used to manure, which is what actually happens - and it rewards varying scents rather than setting one up and forgetting it. Off: only foul smells fade, which preserves the full mood bonus of incense and perfumes.
